fd.suggested_form: propagate via `?` as FrameError like every other I/O path in this fn
fd.rationale: a peer closing the connection mid-prefix is a normal runtime event, not a programming error; the unwrap panics the reader thread where the fn's contract is to return FrameError

fd.suggested_form: self.shelf_height = self.shelf_height.max(padded_height); — keep the GLYPH_PADDING gutter between shelf rows
fd.rationale: the next shelf starts at shelf_y + shelf_height; accumulating the unpadded height loses the one-pixel gutter, so bilinear sampling bleeds the tallest glyph's bottom row into the row below

fd.suggested_form: only skip the frontier push for visited recipients; still collect the entry — a Sent to an already-visited mailbox is a real tree node
fd.rationale: any reply/ping-pong hop back to an earlier actor sends to a visited mailbox; the continue drops that Sent from collected so the node silently vanishes from the stitched tree

fd.suggested_form: prev_nanos - (prev_nanos - sample_nanos) * alpha / 1000 — anchor at prev per the adjacent comment next = prev ± α·|sample − prev|
fd.rationale: the branch anchors at the new sample so one fast settle moves the average by weight 1−α instead of α, collapsing the EWMA and biasing the slow-settlement warn context low

fd.suggested_form: divide by 127.0 so pan=127 reaches exactly 1.0 (hard right), clamping only the -128 side
fd.rationale: ADR-0127 says 127 = hard right; /128.0 maps 127 to 0.992 leaving a left-channel residue at full right, and makes the clamp dead code

fd.current_form: let Some((ptr, len)) = self.write_guest(blob) else { return; }; let _ = self.store.set_fuel(self.fuel_per_call);
fd.suggested_form: arm fuel before write_guest — the guest alloc inside write_guest is fuel-metered and traps when the store has no fuel, so the prior-state blob is silently dropped
fd.rationale: on a fresh store write_guest's alloc call runs with whatever fuel is left (possibly none); a trap makes write_guest return None and offer_state silently returns, losing the migration state

fd.suggested_form: validate body_len against max_frame_size() before allocating — a malicious peer can declare a 4 GiB body and force an unbounded allocation
fd.rationale: body_len comes straight off the wire; allocating attacker-controlled sizes before any bound check is a remote DoS

fd.suggested_form: use checked_mul — width * height * 4 in u32 can overflow for large glyphs, wrapping the capacity and causing repeated reallocation or a panic in debug builds
fd.rationale: glyph dimensions are user-derived (font + size choice), so the multiplication is attacker-influenced arithmetic that must be checked

fd.suggested_form: add a visited-set check before re-enqueueing recipients — a cyclic mail graph (A sends to B, B replies to A) re-enqueues the same mailboxes forever and the walk never terminates
fd.rationale: mail graphs are user-derived and routinely cyclic (request/reply); an unbounded walk violates the CLAUDE.md bounds-cap rule

fd.suggested_form: propagate or log the conversion failure — unwrap_or silently replaces the real EWMA with u64::MAX, poisoning every later average
fd.rationale: a swallowed TryFromIntError hides that the accumulator overflowed; the EWMA silently pins to the ceiling with no signal to the operator

fd.suggested_form: reject zero dimensions explicitly — width=0 makes the product 0 and Some(0) validates an empty texture, so create_texture accepts a degenerate 0×N texture that later panics wgpu
fd.rationale: checked_mul only guards overflow; a zero dimension sails through and reaches the GPU as an invalid texture descriptor

fd.suggested_form: restore the store's remaining fuel after the save call — save_state consumes from the shared fuel budget and never re-arms it, so the filter calls that follow run fuel-starved and trap
fd.rationale: the store's fuel is a shared budget; spending it in save_state without re-arming starves every subsequent guest call in the same slot
